competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, apply only to a subset of items, or be misread from a non-current policy version.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items.
refutation_criterion: Current authoritative policy evidence states a different return window, different refund conditions, or excludes standard items from the 30-day full-refund window.
